invented.quote: and about $29,000 gone in one year.
invented.why: The brief gives $900 as the current price per trip, not the price per trip in 2016–2017.

invented.quote: but I never got back to 170.
invented.why: The brief gives booking numbers for 2016, the next season, two years later, and the current average of 160, but does not state whether bookings ever reached 170 in the intervening years.
